name: Paris, France
description: Explore the city of love with its iconic Eiffel Tower, world-class museums, and charming cafés spread across historic streets.

name: Tokyo, Japan
description: A vibrant mix of tradition and technology, Tokyo offers ancient temples, futuristic districts, and unforgettable cuisine.

name: New York City, USA
description: The city that never sleeps welcomes you with iconic landmarks, Broadway shows, and diverse neighborhoods full of culture.

name: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil
description: Golden beaches, breathtaking landscapes, and a vibrant cultural scene make Rio an unforgettable destination.

name: Cape Town, South Africa
description: A stunning coastal city surrounded by mountains, famous for its natural beauty, history, and rich cultural heritage.

name: Sydney, Australia
description: Enjoy sunny beaches, a relaxed lifestyle, and iconic architecture in one of the most famous cities in the world.

name: Rome, Italy
description: Walk through centuries of history in Rome, where ancient ruins, stunning architecture, and authentic Italian cuisine meet at every corner.

name: Bangkok, Thailand
description: A city full of contrasts, Bangkok offers vibrant street life, ornate temples, and some of the most flavorful food in the world.

name: Vancouver, Canada
description: Surrounded by mountains and ocean, Vancouver blends urban life with nature, offering outdoor adventures and a high quality of life.

name: Buenos Aires, Argentina
description: The birthplace of tango invites you to experience rich culture, European-style architecture, and an unforgettable culinary scene.

name: Auckland, New Zealand
description: A modern city built between volcanoes and the sea, Auckland is the gateway to breathtaking landscapes and outdoor adventures.
